content: Samsung One UI camera Pro Video mode exposes explicit mic picker (Omni/Front/Rear) but this is camera-app-specific UI, not a system API; no public Samsung API to force which physical mic AudioSource.CAMCORDER binds to — it is determined by the device audio policy/HAL mapping tied to camcorder use case, consistent with AOSP behavior. No user-facing OS toggle exists to disable the bad mic.
